durable_files.notes: public places tier, z6-18, layer places. z6-7 are a fraction-preserving sample of the 2,072,349 input places, six attributes, capped at 500,000 bytes per tile; z8-18 are byte-identical to the live places tileset. commands: tippecanoe -Z6 -z7 --drop-fraction-as-needed -M 500000 -r1 -l places -o <work>/parts/z6-7.mbtiles <slim.ndjson> (only z6 is kept); tippecanoe -Z7 -z7 -r1 --no-feature-limit --no-tile-size-limit -l places -o <work>/parts/z7.mbtiles <z7-sample.ndjson> (seeded religion-stratified sample, fraction in the parameters);sqlite insert into tiles select ... from places.mbtiles.tiles where zoom_level >= 8 (read-only attach); pmtiles convert places-v2-20260722.mbtiles places-v2-20260722.pmtiles. Location is a machine-local build output on green, a cache and not a durable store; the durable copy is the R2 object, once uploaded and recorded.
